mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that multiplicative drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through combined earnings and spending effects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 10th percentile historical levels.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) activates accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as the Fed delays rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates strengthening supply-side economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1450 thousand units signal strong residential construction that boosts consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1450.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as policy shifts accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates a tight labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.
